CVE-0000-00001

acme/archive: crafted archive can write outside the target directory

Summary

The extraction routines in acme/archive (Unpack, UnpackLayer) do not confine filesystem operations to the destination directory. A crafted archive can create or overwrite files outside the intended destination.

Details

Paths are checked lexically, while the filesystem operation follows links created by the archive itself.

Impact

Anyone who controls the archive can write files the extracting process can write.

Workarounds

Only extract trusted archives.

Related CVE(s)

EXAMPLE-0000-00001, CVE-0000-00001

Properties: Indirect dependency
